description: Plan your film with a 6-frame storyboard: upload shots or sketch notes, set the shot type and add director's notes.

faqs.a: The board is a 1600 px wide PNG with 2 columns × 3 rows — each frame has a 16:9 image, shot type and your notes.
faqs.q: What does the storyboard look like?

faqs.a: Yes — frames without an image get a numbered placeholder, so you can storyboard with notes alone.
faqs.q: Can I use it without uploading images?

faqs.a: Wide, Medium, Close-up, Extreme close-up, Aerial and POV — the standard shot vocabulary.

howto: For each of the 6 frames, optionally upload a shot image.
Pick the shot type and type your director's notes.
Click "Download storyboard" to save the PNG.
title: Storyboard Maker
